name: review-room
description: Agent-controlled adversarial reviews with local harnesses and a native discussion panel.

interface.longDescription: The chat agent selects enabled reviewers, prompts them to read code, discusses findings, and collects review artifacts. Review Room shows progress and peer dialogue; native settings control harnesses, models, and session reuse.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run an adversarial review of my current changes using Review Room.
